shared_elements: repeated figures in profile arranged in a row
architectural columns/pillars as part of the setting
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief figures in profile organised into horizontal registers, with a row of repeated same-facing figures in one band, which is a broad compositional convention rather than a specific shared motif. A depicts a procession of naturalistically proportioned human figures in robes carrying staffs, while B depicts schematic animals (quadrupeds, a bird, a large-beaked head) with no human procession, and the rendering conventions (rounded modelled drapery vs flat outlined schematic beasts) differ markedly.
